reasons.brotliBytes: Raised from 1_448_095 after the shared-authority extraction series reduced the Soundscaper startup graph from 6,021,507 to 6,019,078 raw bytes while splitting it from 69 to 71 requests. Brotli size rose to 1,449,275 because independently compressed semantic chunks lose cross-chunk compression, not because the shipped graph grew. The 1,453,500 ceiling leaves about 0.29% bounded headroom while preserving the 6,056,688-byte raw, 75-request and 500,000-byte chunk ceilings.

reasons.rawBytes: Raised from 6_700_000 by the project owner. Framescaper's graph had drifted to within 2,381 bytes of that ceiling, so the next commit of any size breached it regardless of what it contained: the compressor and limiter metering work grew the graph 6,729 bytes and tipped it over. A ceiling with 0.036% slack reports commit order rather than startup cost.
reasons.brotliBytes: The brotli ceiling was raised from 1_600_000 for the same reason: the compact layout (chrome drawer, compact bar and its stylesheet) grew the shell a few kilobytes and landed 1,348 bytes over a ceiling the graph had already crept up to. Raised from 1_650_000 to 1_655_000 for hour-long audio import/export: foreground progress/cancellation and actual persistent-storage admission add shared startup code, while codecs, waveform activation, provenance admission, and import execution remain deferred. The final graph measured about 1_650_139 compressed bytes, within 139 bytes of the previous ceiling; the 5,000-byte adjustment (0.30%) gives bounded headroom without changing the 7,000,000-byte raw, 84-request, or 500,000-byte chunk ceilings. Raised from 1_655_000 to 1_655_500 for accessible project tabs: stable per-instance tab IDs and a tablist owning only selection tabs keep adjacent close buttons independently accessible and remove the existing WCAG required-children violations. The corrected graph measured 1_655_249 compressed bytes with canonical installed dependencies; this 500-byte allowance preserves the raw-byte, request and chunk ceilings. Raised from 1_655_500 to 1_656_500 after Audacity-style clip and selection boundary snapping added 652 compressed bytes to the shared timeline startup code. The pre-merge graph measured 1_655_174 and the merged graph measured 1_655_826, exceeding the prior ceiling by 326 bytes. The 1,000-byte adjustment leaves 674 bytes of headroom (about 0.04%) without changing the raw-byte, request, or chunk ceilings. Raised from 1_656_500 to 1_657_000 for same-track 2 ms microfade crossfades and their sample-zoom presentation. The measured graph is 1_656_837 compressed bytes; the 500-byte increase leaves 163 bytes of headroom without changing raw bytes, requests, or chunk ceilings. The microphone flyout branch independently measured 1_655_557 compressed bytes and raised its forked ceiling to 1_656_000; that allowance is covered by this later 1_657_000 ceiling.
reasons.requests: Requests raised from 80 by the same reasoning. The ceiling had no slack at all: the graph sat at exactly 80 of 80, so the next chunk of any origin broke the build, and the file-splitting campaign the maintainability guard asks for adds chunks by construction. Two of the three requests that breached it were real defects and are fixed rather than absorbed here: an extracted `live-capability-policy` had no chunk owner and took a request of its own, and the `aup4-` split left three lazy-only archive modules owned by the eager editor domain. The third is the Labeled audio submenu's own footprint, which is genuine startup cost.
